style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm bakery breakfast visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of oat-milk cream #FFF6EA, pale wheat #E8D3B5, roasted amber accent #A9713A and deep roasted cocoa #3E2A1C; soft warm morning side light around 5000K with soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons in #A9713A only; clean appetizing food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable bread stack scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for group shots, straight-on eye-level for packshot, consistent bread stack scale across the set
